messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary:

Patient Information: 
The patient is a 26-year-old female who was referred to the Medical Oncology department for surgical resection of multiple hepatic metastases. The patient had previously undergone a subtotal gastrectomy for an epithelioid GIST variant localised to the muscularis propia and was diagnosed with pT1pN0 (0/1) with a high mitotic rate - stage II. The patient was found to be positive for CD117 (KIT) and DOG1. The mutational analysis revealed that the tumor was KIT and PDGFRα WT.

Hospital Course:
The patient underwent complete resection of the hepatic metastases and subsequent image studies confirmed no evidence of disease. Adjuvant treatment with imatinib was not delivered due to complete resection of WT GIST. 

Family History:
The patient has a 19-year-old healthy brother. There is no significant family history of diseases; however, the patient's paternal grandparent was diagnosed with a pituitary adenoma at age 30 and died at age 52.

Genetic Testing:
Based on the patient's molecular features of diagnosed GIST, age at presentation and apparently irrelevant family history, SDHx germline analysis was performed in peripheral blood. No further details of the genetic test were provided.

Follow-Up:
The patient is currently 26 years of age and has no evidence of active disease. Additional follow-up appointments may be required as per the physician's recommendation. 
Discharge Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Discharge Instructions:
The patient has been advised to follow up with her physician as required and to notify medical professionals of any adverse symptoms. No further specific discharge instructions were provided.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.
